thread.title: Netflix Could Top 200 Million Subscribers By 2020: Analyst

author: Investor's Business Daily
title: Netflix Could Top 200 Million Subscribers By 2020: Analyst
text:
Shutterstock photo
Netflix ( NFLX ) stock climbed to its third record high in as many days on Wednesday as investors continue to weigh the internet television network's big subscriber gains in the fourth quarter.
BTIG analyst Richard Greenfield on Wednesday reiterated his buy rating on Netflix stock and raised his 12-month price target to 330 from 225. Greenfield now believes Netflix will exceed 200 million global streaming subscribers by 2020, up from his previous estimate of 176 million.
Netflix ended 2017 with 117.58 million streaming subscribers worldwide, including 54.75 million in the U.S. and 62.83 million in foreign markets.
"While it took Netflix 10 years to reach 100 million streaming subscribers, we expect it to take only 2-1/2 years to reach the next 100 million," Greenfield said in a note to clients "The virtuous circle of more subscribers at higher prices is enabling Netflix to invest in more/better content that is attracting more subscribers who are willing to pay more per month."
Netflix shares were up 3.6%, near 259.40, in afternoon trading on the stock market today . In intraday trading Wednesday, Netflix hit a record high of 260.05.
IBD'S TAKE: Netflix stock has a best-possible IBD Composite Rating of 99. For more analysis on Netflix and its peers, visit the IBD Stock Checkup .
Netflix is accelerating subscriber growth through its spending on original content and marketing efforts, because it knows competition from Apple ( AAPL ) and Walt Disney ( DIS ) is coming in 2019, he said.
Netflix late Monday said it added 8.33 million subscribers worldwide in the fourth quarter, soundly beating its target of 6.3 million. It credited popular original TV shows like "Stranger Things" and "The Crown," as well as movies like "Bright" for its robust subscriber additions in the period.
